hypotheses.name: Directed and signed topology multiseed replication
hypotheses.method: Replicated H50 across immune/lung/external_lung with seeds 42/43/44, source/target-disjoint splits, and layers {0,3,7,11}; built directed/signed kNN topology scores from support-direction margins and compared against distance-only cycle baseline under degree-orientation, sign-shuffle, and split-label-placebo nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC=+0.01461; positive rows 58/72; domain-split Fisher significant 6/6; one domain-split mean delta negative (lung source_disjoint=-0.00359)
hypotheses.next_action: Promote to stricter directed nulls with higher permutation budget and investigate why lung source_disjoint is negative while other domain-splits remain positive.

hypotheses.name: Directed path-homology surrogate pilot
hypotheses.method: Seed42 pilot on immune/lung/external_lung with source/target-disjoint splits and layers {7,11}; computed directed flag-complex path-homology surrogate scores (Betti-1 over distance+margin filtrations) vs distance-only cycle baseline with degree-orientation, sign-shuffle, and random-map nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC=+0.00276; positive rows 8/12; domain-split Fisher significant 0/6
hypotheses.next_action: Stop expansion of this exact pilot and only revisit path homology with a materially changed transfer/utility objective or denser directed complex construction.

hypotheses.name: Local linearity rupture index screen
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung and seeds 42/43/44 on source/target-disjoint splits and layers {0,3,7,11}, computed per-gene local reconstruction-error trajectories and rupture indices, then compared rupture edge scores against local-linearity baseline under layer-order shuffle, endpoint-swap (degree-bin), and label-permutation nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC=-0.04527; positive rows 20/72; domain-split mean delta positive 1/6; domain-split Fisher significant 1/6
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this rupture-index formulation and avoid further intrinsic-dimension spend unless a materially different endpoint or causal anchor is introduced.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Rupture-index formulation is strongly negative and intrinsic-dimension family already has repeated inconclusive/negative outcomes under prior controls.
